script: Captains, here's how to fill your roster. Number one: say exactly who you need, the position, the level and the day. Number two: every player brings one friend. Number three: keep a list of five subs. Send this to your captain, and post your opening on Cancha.
caption:
Captains: 3 ways to fill your roster 📋⚽️

1. Say exactly who you need: position, level, day and area. "Need players" gets ignored; "Need a keeper, competitive, Sundays in Doral" gets replies.
2. Every player brings one friend.
3. Keep a list of 5 subs you can text before kickoff.

Send this to your captain 👇 and post your opening on Cancha (link in bio).

🎵 Music: "Rising Tide" by Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), CC BY 4.0.
